## Publication State

The volume overview pages and their canonical LaTeX sources are **available** at the reviewed revision. Their notebook companions are **scaffolded**, meaning the file and tutorial title exist; that status does not establish numerical correctness, successful execution, dependency availability, or reproducibility. The proximal-to-distal monograph is an **available computational publication** with an immutable source manifest and exact PDF, chapter, and evidence contracts. It is not a completed or peer-reviewed textbook, an archival or PID-registered publication, human validation, coaching guidance, or a software capability promise.

Use the cards below or the Read menu to move between these pages. Individual chapter pages are indexed in [Article Index](../resources/articles.html).

## Core Textbooks and Monographs

::: {.resource-grid .resource-grid--long-form}
::: {.resource-card}
### The Physics of Golf

Golf-specific textbook chapters on mechanics, control-affine modeling, multibody dynamics, shaft behavior, impact, and motor control.

[Open The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html){.resource-link}
:::
::: {.resource-card}
### The Geometry of Motion

Mathematical and computational foundations for rigid-body dynamics, nonlinear control, biomechanics, neural control, and simulation.

[Open The Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html){.resource-link}
:::
::: {.resource-card}
### Proximal-to-Distal Energy Transfer in the Golf Swing

A version-pinned 37-chapter technical monograph on model-conditioned transfer mechanisms, counterfactual attribution, uncertainty, falsification, and open evidence boundaries.

[Open the Technical Monograph](../articles/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/index.html){.resource-link}
[Download the Exact 252-Page PDF](../articles/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/proximal_distal_energy_transfer.pdf){.resource-link}
:::
:::

## Forward Dynamics Matching Research Book

A comprehensive research manuscript reviews UpstreamDrift's matching methods, classical estimation, learned proposals, identifiability, and a proposed adaptive model design. Its evidence ledger distinguishes implemented code, historical experiments, unresolved references, and future validation. The manuscript is awaiting publication gates; it does not announce a qualified adaptive matcher.

[Read Matching Forward Dynamics to Kinematic Data](../articles/forward_dynamics_matching/index.html)

## Proximal-to-Distal Study Library

Use the technical monograph as the version-pinned reference. Choose the companion for a more accessible reading path, the summary for a shorter synthesis, and the workbench for exploratory model runs. A model result remains conditional on its declared system, state, inputs, and comparison; none of these routes establishes human validation or a universal swing prescription.

- [Technical Monograph](../articles/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/index.html): the computational publication, exact source authority, equations, claims, falsifiers, and evidence ledgers.
- [How a Golf Swing Carries Energy](../articles/proximal-distal-a-journey-through-the-swing.html): a 30-chapter visual companion with the same interpretation boundaries.
- [Technical Summary](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html): a shorter route through the central counterfactual and energy-accounting arguments.
- [Interactive Model Workbench](../articles/proximal-distal-model-workbench.html): guided exploratory experiments whose outputs are not measured golfer data.
